sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows insulin human is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The Baxter Healthcare Corporation plant (FEI 1416980) that manufactures a labeled insulin human product was classified OAI on 2026-04-02 per inspection 1311078.
FDA issued a warning letter to that plant on 2026-09-29.
An ongoing Class II recall (D-0806-2026) for Baxter's insulin human in 0.9% sodium chloride injection was initiated 2026-08-06 for CGMP deviations.
The rule-recommended option is to buy from Eli Lilly and Company, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

rejected.text: Corvale Lakeside holds 51 units at 3.1 per day, giving 16.7 days on hand, the lowest of the three sites.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
